rows.en: ＊Natsuno＊＠０８６＿００３Morning! Hey, have you￥decided what you're training￥today?
＊Natsuno＊＠０８６＿００４I plan to work on my piloting!￥If you haven't decided yet, want￥to come to the Hangar with me?
＊Natsuno＊＠０８６＿００５Great! With the two of us,￥I just know everything will￥go smoothly!
＊Natsuno＊＠０８６＿００６Oh, too bad. Well, let's go￥together some other time,￥when it works for you!
